integrity: An analytic proof covers all stated parameters and all initial conditions. Numerical tests are supplementary. Priority remains subject to externally unavailable full literature and independent evaluation.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem only at logistic growth \(\mu=2\), with \(0<\varepsilon<1/2\), \(x_0\in[0,1]\), and \(\operatorname{sgn}(0)=0\). Not a claim for general growth, stochastic dispersal or transient durations. Full text of the primary 2023 paper was inspected; the full texts of related 1993 and 2024 articles could not be inspected.
title: Exact basin selection and fractional-power response at a discontinuous logistic border
